chapters.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: SIX-FRAME cinematic animation atlas for chapter 工厂出口 of a mobile toy-mecha game. Square canvas, perfectly regular TWO columns by THREE rows, six equal LANDSCAPE 3:2 cells, no gutters, borders or labels. Reading order left-to-right then down. Reference 1 defines the cream/navy/cyan hero Spark with orange forehead stripe and the amber geometric holographic companion Miko; reference 2 is boss-design reference only, never copy the roster layout. Location: orange industrial foundry over clouds, conveyor rails and glowing furnace. Boss: orange stocky furnace guardian with twin shoulder exhausts, first row of reference roster. Row 1 frames 1 and 2: SAME CAMERA wide shot from behind Spark approaching this location, second frame takes one forward step as environmental energy changes. Row 2 frames 3 and 4: SAME CAMERA close-up of Spark extending one hand toward amber hologram Miko above a cyan maintenance relay, frame 3 dim relay then frame 4 it lights up. Row 3 frames 5 and 6: SAME CAMERA wide aftermath shot with this guardian safely powered down/kneeling, peaceful lights returning and small civilian robots, frame 6 more lights ignite as dawn brightens. Each pair should match composition closely to permit actual two-frame animated cuts. Cohesive crisp illustrated sci-fi toy comic art, no human people, expressive cinematic lighting, readable mobile silhouettes, original designs. NO lettering, text, speech bubbles, numbers, watermarks or UI. Make every one of six cells fully illustrated, no blank cells.
